knowledge_gaps: Repeated interests do not necessarily produce repeated item IDs. If preprocessing deduplicates user–item interactions, prefix occurrence counts are always one and the proposed repeat weighting has no effect. The report provides no repeat-frequency measurements.

The repeat multiplier is described as bounded, but 1 + log(1 + max(count - 1, 0)) has no explicit bound. Define a cap, whether counts cover the truncated input or complete training prefix, and how this context is reproduced during inference.

The residual does not exactly preserve baseline behavior when its gate approaches zero: LayerNorm(sasrec + gate * projection(pool)) still applies an additional normalization. Specify embedding scaling, padding masks, gate initialization, and an identity-preserving control so normalization effects are distinguishable from pooling gains.

The supervision comparison changes both objective and negative count. Include one-negative softmax or multi-negative BCE controls where affordable; specify duplicate-negative handling, exhausted eligible catalogs, loss reduction, and temperature. Excluding the complete training history also uses later training interactions to filter negatives at earlier positions; distinguish that sampling policy from prefix-only feature construction.

Reproducibility requires baseline and category validation HR@10, optimizer settings, checkpoint rules, and a concrete allocation of the 43,200 GPU-second budget. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting. Paired user-level uncertainty estimates can help without changing the evaluator.

Originality 4 is plausible, but potential 8 and difficulty 4 are subjective estimates without runtime or effectiveness evidence. Simulator feedback from twenty users motivates hypotheses; it does not establish population-level unmet needs or compatibility. Cited papers also need primary-source verification before supporting specific mechanisms.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether repeat weighting has a usable signal and whether it represents recurring interests rather than repurchases. Actual repeat rates must subsequently be measured from permitted training histories.
follow_up_queries.query: In Amazon sequential recommendation benchmarks using SASRec, how does user–item deduplication affect repeated-item signals? What methods distinguish repeated item purchases from recurring interests across distinct items, using only interaction histories and no pretrained representations?

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve the fusion specification and identify simpler controls before committing to the combined architecture.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec extensions with gated recent-item pooling residuals, what implementations preserve the original model when the gate is zero? Investigate embedding scale, additional LayerNorm, causal padding masks, and comparisons against last-item or recency-weighted pooling baselines.
